decisions.reason: This award-backed yogurt is very close to the firm's core organic dairy range and, having remained in the portfolio, is likely a stable seller worth retaining.
As a prominently positioned flagship-style cheese that fits the firm's brand and cheese competence, it is unlikely to be withdrawn absent clear underperformance.
The spicy cheese line extends the established cheese offer in a plausible way, though multiple variants create some ongoing portfolio-simplification risk.
This washed-rind soft cheese is still the most niche of the surviving launches, but its artisanal fit with the firm's organic cheese profile justifies keeping it unless sales weaken.
